result.instructions: Tools for Shopper Approved, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show all 1-star and 2-star seller reviews from the last 30 days."; "What is our average seller rating and how many reviews do we have?"; "Which products have the most reviews, and which have the lowest rating?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shopper Approved data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shopperapproved_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shopperapproved_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shopperapproved_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shopperapproved_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shopperapproved_list_reviews
tools.title: List seller reviews
tools.description: List the store's seller (service) reviews: review ID, date, reviewer name, rating, comment and media. Results are for the customer's own use. Shopper Approved API: GET /reviews/{siteid}.

from.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd. If you leave it out, the API returns only the last 30 days. Use an old date (for example 2010-01-01) for all reviews.

rating.description: Comma list of ratings to keep, for example 1,2,3.

removed.description: Set to 1 to include removed reviews.

full_name.description: Set to 1 to return the full reviewer name.

tools.name: shopperapproved_get_review
tools.title: Get a review by order ID
tools.description: Get one seller review by the order ID that was sent with the order. Shopper Approved API: GET /reviews/{siteid}/{reviewid}.

order_id.description: The order ID of the review.

removed.description: Set to 1 to include removed reviews.

full_name.description: Set to 1 to return the full reviewer name.

annotations.title: Get a review by order ID

tools.name: shopperapproved_list_product_reviews
tools.title: List product reviews
tools.description: List product reviews for the whole store, newest data by date range. Shopper Approved API: GET /products/reviews/{siteid}.

from.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd. If you leave it out, the API returns only the last 30 days. Use an old date (for example 2010-01-01) for all reviews.

removed.description: Set to 1 to include removed reviews.

tools.name: shopperapproved_get_product_reviews
tools.title: Get reviews for one product
tools.description: Get the reviews of one product. A parent ID returns the reviews of all products with that parent ID. Shopper Approved API: GET /products/reviews/{siteid}/{productid}.

product_id.description: Product ID or parent ID, as sent in your product feed to Shopper Approved.

from.description: Start date, yyyy-mm-dd. If you leave it out, the API returns only the last 30 days. Use an old date (for example 2010-01-01) for all reviews.

removed.description: Set to 1 to include removed reviews.

tools.name: shopperapproved_get_review_stats
tools.title: Get seller review statistics
tools.description: Get the aggregate statistics of the store's seller reviews (totals and average rating). Shopper Approved API: GET /aggregates/reviews/{siteid}.

tools.name: shopperapproved_get_product_stats
tools.title: Get product review statistics
tools.description: Get the total number of product reviews, and the review count and rating of each product. Shopper Approved API: GET /aggregates/products/{siteid}.

by_match_key.description: Group the numbers by group ID.

tools.name: shopperapproved_get_product_stat
tools.title: Get statistics for one product
tools.description: Get the review count and rating of one product. Shopper Approved API: GET /aggregates/products/{siteid}/{productid}.
